description.zh: 当all=true时按照beignTime的顺序返回两侧对话文本
description.en: If this parameter is set to `true`, the operation returns the two-party conversation text, sorted chronologically by `beginTime`.

description.zh: 通话类型；1:呼入,2:webcall,4:预览外呼,5:预测外呼,6:主叫外呼,9:内部呼叫
description.en: Specifies the call type. Valid values are: 1 (inbound call), 2 (web call), 4 (preview outbound call), 5 (predictive outbound call), 6 (agent-initiated outbound call), and 9 (internal call).
The unique identifier of the main channel.
